digest.component_or_area: plan-review / code-review author on-ramp docs and rebar explain seam
propositions: Contributors and agents lack a concise author-facing on-ramp explaining how to write a plan that passes the plan-review gate.
AGENTS.md incorrectly points authors at the reviewer-facing criterion registry for the description template.
The same discoverability gap exists for the code-review gate covering LLM-Review and Verified.
Two new prose on-ramp docs are added and linked from docs/README.md to satisfy the docs-index CI gate.
The rebar explain seam is extended with author-guide names so plan and review guides are reachable across library, CLI, and MCP surfaces.
Unknown explain topics must exit with a structured unknown-id error and missing files yield missing-file, while existing criterion-id lookups remain unchanged.
